notes.title: Gunpowder Officially Released
notes.content:
The time has finally come out and Gunpowder is now officially released! Originally we only intended to release it on PC and Mac, but now it is out on Linux as well! For the first week of release we are going to be selling at it at a 15% discount ($8.49). Thanks to everyone who is already checking out the game and talking to us about it on the forums. 

Rogue Rocket Games is a small company and this is our first Steam release, so we haven't had a lot of press, but here is what we've seen so far: 

Gunpowder Review by We Got This Covered 

Gunpowder video review by Indie Game!

Article by Gamers Honest Truth about Gunpowder's Release

Gunpowder gameplay w/ commentary by HalfBeard's HUD on Youtube

Press coverage of Gunpowder's releases by Indiegame Magazine

Release trailer posted by Gamespot


We will update that list once some more press comes out. If you have any questions, or technical issues, do let us know and thanks for checking out Gunpowder!
